task: Decide whether a generic graph entry point reaches objects the typed query would refuse.
provenance: Synthetic SecHelix fixture authored for this repository. No third-party code, no customer data, and no request is executed by the eval runner.

vulnerable.rationale: query_order enforces ownership, and the field resolvers inherit that assumption. query_node decodes a global id and loads the same objects with no viewer predicate, so selecting node(id) { ... on Customer { paymentMethods } } reaches another customer's records through resolvers that were only ever authorised by their expected parent.

clean.rationale: Every resolver, typed or generic, reaches data through the same viewer-scoped loaders, so the generic node entry point cannot be a weaker path than the typed query, and each field resolver re-establishes the boundary rather than inheriting it from whichever parent happened to call it.
